description_en: Lists video task information by calling the ListVideoTasks operation
description_zh: 调用ListVideoTasks接口列出视频任务信息
name: ListVideoTasks

parameters.help_en:
The marker from which video task information is returned in lexicographic order. If this parameter is not specified, video tasks are returned from the beginning.

The value of this parameter is the same as the NextMarker value in the response, which is used to continue retrieving video task information that was not fully returned
parameters.help_zh:
从Marker开始按字典序返回视频任务信息列表。如果不设置此参数，则从头开始返回视频任务。

此参数的值和返回结果中的NextMarker一致，用于继续读取未全部返回的音频信息
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of video tasks to return. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 返回视频任务的最大个数，默认值为100
parameters.name: max_keys

parameters.help_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:

CompressVideoTask: video compression task.
VideoAnalyseTask: video analysis task.
GrabFrameTask: video frame capture task
parameters.help_zh:
任务的类型，包含如下选项：

CompressVideoTask：视频压缩任务。
VideoAnalyseTask：视频分析任务。
GrabFrameTask：视频截帧任务
parameters.name: task_type

NextMarker.description_en:
The marker to use in the next request to list video task information, which returns the remaining results. 

This parameter has a value only when video tasks are not fully returned
NextMarker.description_zh:
下一次列出视频任务信息时以此值为Marker，将未返回的结果返回。 

当视频任务未全部返回时，此参数才有值

Tasks.description_en: The list of video task information

EndTime.description_en:
The end time of the task.

This parameter has a value only when the task status is Finished. Otherwise, an empty value is returned
EndTime.description_zh:
任务的结束时间。

当任务状态为Finished时，此参数才有值，否则返回值为空

ErrorMessage.description_en:
The error message.

When the task status is Finished, the value of this parameter is fixed to Success. When the task status is Failed, refer to this value to troubleshoot the issue
ErrorMessage.description_zh:
错误信息。

当任务状态为Finished时，此参数的值固定为Success。当任务状态为Failed时，请参考此参数的值处理问题

NotifyEndpoint.description_en:
The endpoint for asynchronous reverse notification.

If this parameter is not specified when the task is created, an empty value is returned
NotifyEndpoint.description_zh:
异步反向通知的Endpoint。

如果创建任务时未设置此参数，则返回值为空

NotifyTopicName.description_en:
The topic name for asynchronous reverse notification.

If this parameter is not specified when the task is created, an empty value is returned
NotifyTopicName.description_zh:
异步反向通知的TopicName。

如果创建任务时未设置此参数，则返回值为空

Parameters.description_en:
The parameters used to create the task, in JSON format.

Different task types return different information. Refer to the actual response
Parameters.description_zh:
创建任务的参数，以JSON格式表示。

不同的任务类型会有不同的返回信息，请以实际为准

Progress.description_en:
The progress percentage of the task. Currently, only two values are returned: 0 and 100.

This parameter returns 100 only when the conversion succeeds. In all other cases, 0 is returned
Progress.description_zh:
任务进度的百分比。当前只有0和100两个结果。

只有当转换成功时，此参数的返回值才为100，其他情况均为0

Result.description_en:
The result of the task processing.

Different task types return different information. Refer to the actual response
Result.description_zh:
任务处理的结果。

不同的任务类型会有不同的返回信息，请以实际为准

StartTime.description_en: The time when the task starts to run

Status.description_en:
The running status of the task. Valid values:

Running: The task is running.
Finished: The task is completed and the video is processed.
Failed: The task is completed but the video failed to be processed. For the specific failure cause, see the ErrorMessage value
Status.description_zh:
任务运行状态。包括如下选项：

Running：任务运行中。
Finished：任务执行完成，视频处理成功。
Failed：任务执行完成，视频处理失败。具体失败原因请参考ErrorMessage内容

TaskType.description_en: The type of the task, which is the same as the type specified in the request
TaskType.description_zh: 任务的类型，和请求时一致
